info.description: High-performance production REST API for LIVO Personal Life OS. Features local-first deterministic engines (sweep-line schedule fitting, priority math, day overload evaluator), 8-domain life management (tasks, plan, goals, habits, finance, learning, travel, health), asynchronous event bus, AI orchestrations (Gemini Flash & Groq Whisper), universal add quick capture, and delta offline synchronization.
